item.title: RTDa: Human-centred Intelligent System for Early detection and monitoring of Neurodegenerative diseases via voice Signals Evaluation (HISENSE) (CNR - Istituto di calcolo e reti ad alte prestazioni)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-17 18:00
Institution: CNR - Istituto di calcolo e reti ad alte prestazioni, Napoli

The project involves the development of a human-centered intelligent system for monitoring neurodegenerative diseases through the analysis of voice signals and clinical data. This includes the acquisition and management of sensitive health data, the construction and maintenance of databases, the extraction of features from the signals, the development and validation of interpretable AI models, the identification of voice biomarkers, and support for pilot clinical studies.
